en.name: Eucharistic Miracle of the Fourth Lateran Council
en.summary: A consecrated Host is said to have glowed and remained suspended in the air during a Mass before Pope Innocent III.
en.body: During a Mass celebrated in Rome in the presence of Pope Innocent III in 1215, the Maronite Patriarch Jeremiah al-Amshitti reportedly saw the consecrated Host emit light and remain suspended above his hands after he had lowered them, an event later recorded by later Maronite historians.
